chunks: We have offered every kind of example here in this Qur'an to men. Even then if you bring a verse to them, those who disbelieve say: 'You are nothing but a liar.'

key_terms.ضَرَبْنَا: We have set forth / made an example
key_terms.مُبْطِلُونَ: liars / those who negate the truth

ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers reject the clear examples in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rum underscores the Qur'an's pedagogical versatility, employing diverse 'examples' (mathal) to cater to various levels of human understanding. The persistence of the disbelievers in labeling the revelation as 'fabrication' (mubtilun) highlights the epistemological gap between divine wisdom and human perception, a theme often explored by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni to illustrate the limits of rational acceptance without spiritual insight.
